correctness.rationale: Conditioning on whether labels 1 and 2 co-cluster changes only the block count at time two, from one to two. The Pitman–Yor expected block-count recursion is affine with multiplicative coefficient 1+alpha/(theta+m), so the conditional mean difference evolves exactly by the product R_n. The event probability is (1-alpha)/(theta+1), and exchangeability identifies the covariance with every pair indicator; averaging proves the pair-homozygosity formula. The sample-homozygosity identity is a deterministic affine conversion. Exact enumeration and recurrence replay independently agree with all formulas.

value.rationale: K_n is the canonical finite-sample richness statistic in Ewens–Pitman models, while sample homozygosity/Gini–Simpson diversity is a canonical measure of frequency concentration and a classical neutrality-test statistic. The theorem quantifies their exact finite dependence for the full two-parameter model and, more structurally, identifies the exact richness shift caused by observing one pair to match or differ. The Ewens specialization is especially sharp: pair-diversity covariance is exactly sample-size invariant, equal to theta/(theta+1)^2 for every n. This is a motivated relationship between two standard summaries, not an arbitrary sliced moment.
